title: lint: flow-region-shape-invalid anchors the whole flow; point the finding at the region container at fault
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQxwoGb5fSnrFkpxmt

立卡门: ① 在飞卡欠的后续。#29233 的修正(claim amendment 6585054494)接受了与旧本地规则的三处差异，其中「定位到出错的容器」承诺另开卡。
业务理由: 流程作者看到 `flow-region-shape-invalid` 只知道整个流程有问题，不知道是哪个区域容器(并行、循环等)形状不对。旧的 cli 本地规则会指到容器，挪到注册行后丢了这一层。
动手的读者: domain:server 席。改 #29495 新增的 lint 注册规则 `flow-region-shape-invalid`(`packages/lint` 内 `validateFlowRegionShape`),让发现带上出错容器的路径。
查重: 规则 #29495 尚未合并，没有同题卡。

Follow-up of: #29233 (PR #29526), #29049 (PR #29495)

## Wanted
- The finding's location names the container at fault (its node id / path inside the flow), not only the flow, when the engine's verdict names one. When it doesn't, the flow stays the anchor, as now.
- Still one rule, one judge, one spelling: the engine's sentence is the message; no second call, no second check beside the registry row.
- One finding per container at fault is acceptable; say in the PR which you chose and why.
- Tests in the rule's own test file. `Clause-②: no`. `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Serial
- After PR #29495 (#29049) and PR #29526 (#29233) merge. Same file as #29049: serial with any open card on `validateFlowRegionShape`.
